networks.name: Onflow Ads Cross-Promotion
networks.how_it_works: Opt-in partner directory/open board; the platform bot publishes both approved promotional posts, checks them, and removes them when the run ends.
networks.notes: Free plan advertises a limited monthly cross-promotion allowance. Requires the platform bot to be an admin of our own public channel and an account on the platform. Partner and post approvals are part of its workflow.

networks.name: Adpact Cross-Promotion
networks.how_it_works: Opt-in partner discovery; posts are published and checked by the platform bot. Exchanges consume/earn in-app points.
networks.notes: Both owners review/accept posts. No ad purchase required, but points and platform eligibility rules apply.

networks.name: Trigram Cross-Promotion
networks.how_it_works: The service matches channel owners for post swaps, publishes through its bot, and checks that both posts remain live for the agreed period.
networks.notes: The public catalog also contains paid placements; only the cross-promotion path is in scope.

execution_notes.critical_limitation: Finding a channel whose rules permit promotion is not the same as being authorized to post there. A publisher must already be a member with permission, or an exchange platform must have its bot connected to both channels.
execution_notes.current_live_status: Targets discovered only. No third-party group has been joined, no promo post has been published, and no subscriber increase is claimed.
execution_notes.next_automation_step: Connect an authorized Telegram publishing identity once, then process eligible targets sequentially with rate limits, duplicate suppression, rules checks and per-target conversion tracking.
